tools.name: get_airport_delay_status
tools.description: Get live airport-level delay, cancellation, and weather flight-rules for one airport, plus tomorrow's forecast and departure outlook when one is published. Accepts IATA code, city, or airport name. Airport-level only, not flight-number tracking.

tools.name: airport.get_delay_status
tools.description: Get live airport-level delay, cancellation, and weather flight-rules for one airport, plus tomorrow's forecast and departure outlook when one is published. Accepts IATA code, city, or airport name. Alias of get_airport_delay_status for clients that prefer dot-notation tool names.

tools.name: search_supported_airports
tools.description: Search Pro Flight Search tracked airports when a user's airport reference is ambiguous. Returns matching IATA codes to use with get_airport_delay_status. Call this before airport status when the user says a city name like London or Chicago.

tools.name: airport.search_supported
tools.description: Search Pro Flight Search tracked airports when a user's airport reference is ambiguous. Returns matching IATA codes to use with airport.get_delay_status. Alias of search_supported_airports for clients that prefer dot-notation tool names.
